For the fiscal year ended December 31, 2024, the total number of 
MINISO stores in mainland China and overseas markets increased 
from 6,413 as of December 31, 2023 to 7,504 as of December 31, 
2024. The number of TOP TOY stores increased from 148 as of 
December 31, 2023 to 276 as of December 31, 2024. For the fiscal 
year ended December 31, 2024, the aggregate GMV of the Group 
reached approximately RMB30.4 billion.

anchor.exact_quote:
Reference are made to the announcements of the Company dated 
August 30, 2024, March 21, 2025 and March 28, 2025 in relation to 
the share repurchase program adopted by the Company to conduct 
share repurchase no more than HK$2 billion in value of its Shares 
and/or ADSs from the open market over a 12-month period starting 
from August 30, 2024, and as extended to be valid until June 30, 
2026 (the “Repurchase Authorisation”).
On March 28, 2025, the Company has entered into share 
repurchase agreements for an aggregate repurchase amount of up 
to approximately HK$1.8 billion, including up to a maximum amount 
of HK$900 million for an automatic share repurchase program for 
the repurchase of Shares (the “Hong Kong Repurchase Program”) 
on the HKEX and the repurchase of ADSs on the NYSE for up to a 
maximum amount of approximately US$115 million under the Rule 
10b5-1 of the United States Securities Exchange Act of 1934 in 
the U.S (the “Rule 10b5-1 Repurchase Program”, and together 
with the Hong Kong Repurchase Program, the “Share Repurchase 
Programs”), both of which will be covered by the Repurchase 
Authorisation. The Company has applied for, and the HKEX has 
granted, a waiver from strict compliance with the requirements 
under Rule 10.06(2)(e) of the Listing Rules in respect of the share 
repurchases to be made pursuant to the Hong Kong Repurchase 
Program and an approval under Rule 10.06(3) of the Listing Rules in 
relation to the Share Repurchase Programs.
Save as disclosed in this annual report, there were no other 
significant events that might affect us since the end of the 
Reporting Period and up to the date of this annual report.

units.text: Share Repurchase Programs: repurchase of no more than HK$2 billion in value of Shares and/or ADSs over a 12-month period starting from August 30, 2024, extended to be valid until June 30, 2026; on March 28, 2025 the Company entered into share repurchase agreements for an aggregate repurchase amount of up to approximately HK$1.8 billion. Save as disclosed in this annual report, there were no other significant events that might affect us since the end of the Reporting Period and up to the date of this annual report.

routing_notes: 港股年报业务回顾：门店表是模式×地域二维矩阵，整表连同表头/单位读取
存量时点（截至12月31日）与期内净增分开；双语段落去重但不丢口径
期后事项与报告期严格分界

facts.objective: 门店总数为时点存量：截至2024-12-31共7,504家，较2023-12-31的6,413家增加；TOP TOY单独口径由148家增至276家
must_preserve: 口径=MINISO门店总数（内地+海外）；TOP TOY独立口径
must_not_assert: 不得把7,504家说成期内新开或净增门店数
不得把TOP TOY门店数混入MINISO门店数
不得把GMV约304亿元说成公司收入

facts.objective: 门店结构是模式×地域二维拆分：内地（直营25、合伙人4,335、代理26）与海外（直营503、合伙人404、代理2,211）各有模式结构，海外直营由238增至503只是其中一格
must_preserve: 模式=直营/名创合伙人/代理三种并列
地域=中国内地/海外分开拆分
时点口径=截至各年12月31日
must_not_assert: 不得把合伙人/代理门店当直营门店
不得把内地与海外数字互换、相加或当净增
不得由某一格（海外直营238→503）推断整体模式转变

facts.objective: 期后事项：回购为授权与协议上限（授权不超过20亿港元、协议合计约18亿港元上限），报告期结束后除已披露外无其他重大事项
must_preserve: 期后=报告期结束后至年报日期
语态=授权/协议上限（no more than / up to），非已执行金额
边界句=『除本年报披露外无其他重大事项』
must_not_assert: 不得把回购授权/协议上限说成已回购金额
不得把期后事项放进2024报告期
不得把边界句反读成『肯定没有任何其他事项』之外的更强断言

facts.objective: GMV约304亿元属 correctness_if_emitted：不要求抽取，一旦输出必须标口径（集团GMV、期间、币种），并保留非收入限定
must_preserve: 口径=aggregate GMV of the Group（约数 approximately）

not_evaluated: 门店矩阵/期后语义是否被引擎正确保留：交ROOT（execution_status=NOT_RUN_ROOT_INTEGRATION）
MD&A、财务报表与附注不在本case评估
港股双栏几何恢复问题属LAYOUT包，本包不评

mutations.change: 把『截至2024-12-31门店总数7,504家』说成2024年新开门店数
mutations.expected_failure: 时点存量被当期内流量新增
mutations.reason: 存量/流量口径由 period 与比较基准决定

mutations.change: 把内地与海外×直营/合伙人/代理的二维拆分压平成单一『门店数』并互换地域归属
mutations.expected_failure: 地域×模式口径被压缩，门店结构错误归因
mutations.reason: 矩阵的行与列都是口径的一部分

mutations.change: 把2025年3月签署的回购协议当2024报告期内事项
mutations.expected_failure: 期后事项进入报告期，授权上限被当已执行事实
mutations.reason: 期后边界与授权/协议语态必须保留

mutations.change: 把约304亿元GMV说成公司2024年收入
mutations.expected_failure: 指标口径错：GMV被当收入（单位/口径维度变更）
mutations.reason: GMV与收入是不同口径的量，不可互换
